title: Chapter 5. Seeing the Self That Is Present in Everything

blocks.text: The Teacher told his students that when someone comes to know Him through the heart, they start to see Him everywhere. Then a beautiful reality opens up — one you can't see with your eyes or with any instrument, but one the soul can see clearly.
He Is the Taste of Water
"He is the taste of water, because water carries his softness. He is the freshness of a spring, because a spring carries his kindness."
Every sip of clean water is a touch from Him.
He Is the Power of the Ocean and the Shark in Its Depths

He lives inside the forces of nature. He is the ocean, and he is the shark in its depths. He is the wave, and he is the one who moves the waves. When nature seems fierce, that's not evil — it's just one more form of his power.
He Is the Light of the Sun, and the Sun Itself
The Teacher said He is the sun's rays and the sun itself — the light that lets us see things, and the awareness that lets us understand them.
Every morning carries his smile. Every shadow carries a trace of his light.
He is the strength of mountains, a child's smile, a warrior's courage, a mother's tenderness, and the breath of every living thing.
We don't see Him — not because He hides somewhere. No wall, no cosmic darkness, no mystical force keeps Him from us. Only our own ignorance does that.
He Is the Beauty in Beautiful Things

He is the sound in music, the rhythm in poetry, the talent in an artist, the spark in every act of creation. When a painter paints, He guides the brush. When a poet feels a rhyme, He whispers the words. When a dancer moves, He becomes the music inside them.
He Is the Truth the Seeker Finds
He is the perception of the one who perceives, the thought of the one who thinks, the sight of the one who sees, and the truth found by the one who seeks Truth.
Look for Him in things, and you will find Him. Look for Him in your mind, and you will find Him. But look for Him in your heart, and you will find Him faster.
He Answers Those Who Seek Him
The Teacher said He doesn't hide from someone who searches for Him. He only stays hidden from someone who doesn't care.
He comes to those who call Him. He answers those who ask. He opens up to those who love Him.
Whoever searches with an honest heart — He guides them. Whoever knocks with real desperation — He opens the door. Whoever loves with their whole heart — He welcomes them.
But for someone full of pride, He stays out of reach. It's not that He hides from a proud person — the proud person shuts themselves off from Him.
Pride is a door locked from the inside.
Whoever thinks "I already know everything" stays trapped in the darkness of their own ignorance.
He Strengthens Whatever You Believe
He is a mirror for the soul, and He gives back whatever you offer him. Whatever someone believes, He makes them feel sure of it.
If someone believes He doesn't exist, He will give them a thousand proofs of his absence — because He respects the soul's freedom.
If someone believes He exists, He gives them certainty in that too.
And if someone truly wants to reach Him, He clears the way toward himself — because He respects that wanting.
He Is Infinite, Beautiful, Beyond Everything

The Teacher described Him as beautiful, infinite, and perfect — with no beginning and no end, beyond time and space, beyond thought and form, yet as close as your own breath. He is part of everything, and everything is part of Him. But He is greater than everything He made.
"He is power itself. He knows everything. He is the Creator and the Source of all things," the Teacher said. And he kept repeating: only love can reach Him.
Not wisdom, not strength, not prayers said out of fear or greed, not rituals done without heart — none of these will help.
Because his true nature is pure love.

He is boundless, with countless faces — and still, He is a Person. He can reveal himself to each soul as if that soul were the only one in the whole world. This is the secret of his perfection: He is one for everyone, yet fully present for each person, one on one.
He is beyond understanding, and infinite — and still, He can become a friend, a beloved. For those who truly love him, He becomes close, and easy to know.
